verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs show a new Journals page is created automatically each day and that the app opens on the Journals page, which makes it the default place for journaling and capture. A community user also praises the journaling. Nothing in the evidence shows daily notes being pre-filled from a template; the only template evidence covers quick-capture formatting, a different feature. Missing for 10: documented default daily-journal template pre-fill, independent hands-on corroboration of template-based daily notes.

support.subject: As a power-user, I get an automatic daily note for each day, pre-filled from a template, as the default landing place for journaling and capture

citations.quote: Every day at midnight a new Journals page is created with that day's date
Every time you open Logseq, you start on the Journals page.
Logseq's journalling and time-tracking is a beauty.
